settings.heading: Delivery Policy
settings.content:
At Super Shelving, we want your shelving to arrive safely and without fuss. This policy explains where we deliver, how long it takes, how pickup works, and what to do when your order arrives.

1. Where we deliver

We currently deliver within the state of Victoria only.

If you live outside Victoria, you are welcome to arrange your own transport to collect your order. Please contact us before you buy so we can help set this up.

2. Pickup (click and collect)

You can collect your order from our Melbourne warehouse:

Moonee Ponds - 4 Ardmillan Road, Moonee Ponds VIC 3039
Monday to Friday 9am - 6pm
Saturday and Sunday 10am - 5pm

To collect:

  1. Choose Pickup at checkout.
  2. Your order is ready straight away. Once you have your order confirmation email, you can walk in and collect it during our opening hours - no appointment needed.
  3. Bring your order confirmation email (or your order number) when you arrive.
  4. If someone else is collecting for you, they need the same order confirmation email.

If you arranged to pay by Bank Transfer, PayID or Cash for a pickup order, you pay in person at our pickup location when you collect.

Your shelving is packed flat in boxes. Our How To Collect In Your Vehicle guide shows boxed sizes and weights so you can check your vehicle first. You are also welcome to send your own courier to collect your order. Please contact us in advance so we can arrange it.

Uncollected orders: we hold pickup orders for 14 days from your order confirmation. We will email you a reminder after your order confirmation and "ready for pickup" email, so you have plenty of notice. If your order has not been collected within the 14 days, we will treat it as cancelled, keep 50% of the purchase price, and refund the remaining 50%. If you cannot collect in time, please contact us before the 14 days are up so we can work something out.

3. Dispatch and delivery times

  • We aim to dispatch orders as soon as possible. Orders placed on our website are usually dispatched the following business day.
  • Once dispatched, delivery usually takes 1-2 business days, depending on your location.
  • Orders placed on weekends or public holidays are processed on the next business day.
  • During busy periods, sales or public holidays, dispatch may take longer.

These times are estimates, not guarantees. Delays can happen because of stock, weather, public holidays, courier issues or other events outside our control. We will contact you if we expect a significant delay.

We cannot book a specific day, time or time slot for delivery. Delivery dates and times are set by the courier or our delivery team, so please make sure someone can receive your order or tell us a safe spot to leave it.

4. How your order is delivered

Your order is delivered in one of two ways, whichever is cheaper:

  • Courier - picked up from our warehouse and delivered to you by Aramex.
  • In-house delivery - delivered from our warehouse in our own vans or trucks.

We choose the delivery method. You will not be able to choose between them.

Once your order is dispatched, we will send you tracking details by email. Please keep them. If something goes wrong, contact the courier with your tracking number and let us know straight away so we can help follow it up.

5. Delivery costs

Delivery is calculated at checkout based on your postcode and the items and quantity you order. The cost is shown before you pay.

Some larger or heavier orders, or addresses that are hard to reach, may cost more to deliver than the checkout shows. If that happens, we will contact you as soon as we can to discuss. You can accept the extra cost or cancel for a full refund.

For large or bulk orders, please contact us before you order and we can give you a freight quote.

6. Where we deliver to, and receiving your order

  • Please give us a complete and accurate address, and a phone number we can reach on delivery day.
  • Deliveries go to the front door, garage, or ground floor or kerbside of your address. Standard delivery does not include carrying items upstairs, downstairs or inside your home or business. If you need that, you can arrange it separately with the courier when your order is delivered. The courier may charge a fee for this, which you agree with and pay to them directly.
  • Shelving is heavy and bulky. Please make sure someone is available to receive and help move it.
  • If you tell us to leave your order in a particular spot, such as the garage or a locked gate, we will do our best. Once it has been left there, it is your responsibility. We cannot be responsible for goods that go missing from a spot you nominated.
  • Please tell us if access is limited - for example, a narrow driveway, steep driveway, gated property, or no room for a van/truck.

When a delivery cannot be completed: if the courier cannot deliver because of an incorrect address, nobody being available, or restricted access, we will charge a redelivery fee, which is the same cost as the original delivery. It must be paid before we try again. If you ask us to redirect an order to a different address after it has been dispatched, extra charges may apply.

If we cannot deliver to your address at all, we will contact you to talk about options - for example, collecting your order, paying an extra fee, or a refund of the delivery fee so you can organise your own freight. If none of these work, we will give you a full refund.

7. Check your order on arrival

Please check your order when it arrives:

  • Look over the outside of the boxes for damage before the courier leaves where you can, and take photos.
  • Open the boxes and check you have received everything.
  • If anything is damaged, missing or wrong, contact us as soon as possible - ideally within 7 days of delivery - at hello@supershelving.com.au or +61 431 533 520. Please include your order number and photos of the product, the damage, the packaging and the shipping label.
  • Please keep the packaging until the problem is sorted out.

8. Risk and ownership

Risk in the goods passes to you when they are delivered to you or collected. Ownership passes to you once we have received full payment.
